title: 3D Animation | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: 3D Animation. Category: Designing. Duration: 6 months. Description: Computer animation: the process used for digitally generating animations, covering both static scenes (CGI) and moving images. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
